performance_acceptance: No automatic performance acceptance threshold; measured increases are listed for review.
method: Conventional median and nearest-rank p95 computed from raw UI calls, pooled within each scenario/phase. One or two rounds per side; sample counts remain explicit. As-used sequential comparison with uncontrolled clocks/pressure.
timing_scope: ui_ms measures Studio::ui CPU wall duration. input_to_ui_ms starts at raw_input_hook event injection. frame_interval_ms measures successive native UI-call completions, not distinct native callbacks or presented/GPU latency. These harnesses have no raw input sequence ID.
notes: Raw document byte mismatches remain reported. Only fresh authoring entity IDs may differ when a seed-protected bijection preserves every other JSON field/order and all modeled references, with no unclassified changed-ID occurrences.
Native UI screenshots are checked for dimensions, not compared at arbitrary UI states.
Coordination phase frame counts may vary; all deterministic workload phase counts must match.
Small-sample phases such as save do not support statistical significance claims.
